The death of a family leaves a hole in the world that is often overlooked. When there is no one to remember them, no one spares more than a fleeting thought. But I see them. And I bring before the town a horrifying tale. The objects which anchored them to this plane of existence have been stolen from the urns where they were interred.
A bent bayonet, the final tool of a forgotten soldier whose heart would not bend even when his weapons and body broke.  A piece of costume jewelry, a life ruined by shame, and a fruitless labor. A child enshrined in evocative existential dread. An infant unknown, the shoes of which carried the tragedy of grief.

The bodies have been scattered through kingsbridge and the noir. This perverse and profane act is an act of will. A defiance against Huginn and Muninn. It seems to be an act of ritual casting meant to disturb the Noir. Therefore. It is not only perverse but also treason against the twins.

Bring back the objects that anchored the clutter family. It is the only hope to undo this attack on Empire City.
